name: Control Sonos
description: Control Sonos speakers from Asyar: play/pause, skip tracks and change the volume of your group over the local network. Requires a Sonos system.
author: Sylwester Rąpała

preferences.name: room
preferences.title: Hotkey room
preferences.description: Sonos Play / Pause, Next Track and Previous Track control the group this room is in. Sonos Control Center sets it to the group you last used there.

commands.name: Sonos Control Center
commands.description: Play, pause, skip and set the volume of every Sonos group, and allow your speakers

commands.name: Sonos Play / Pause
commands.description: Toggle playback of your Sonos group

commands.name: Sonos Next Track
commands.description: Skip to the next track in the group

commands.name: Sonos Previous Track
commands.description: Go back to the previous track in the group
